questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to conditions coming up. Speed advisory plaques show the safe speed to use.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you are leaving a divided highway and entering a two-way road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction of the arrow. In this case, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic laws you must follow. This sign requires you to drive only in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns that traffic signals are coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped yellow signs warn of danger ahead. Orange diamond signs warn of hazards in or near work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At this sign, you must yield. Slow down and let traffic and pedestrians cross your path before you proceed. Stop if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. You must come to a complete stop and wait until it is safe to proceed through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on the back of slow-moving vehicles like farm equipment, construction machinery, or horse-drawn vehicles that travel slower than 25 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: Look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop. Do not cross until any trains have passed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn your vehicle around to go in the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a side road is coming up ahead. Be alert for traffic entering from the side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns you of a school zone or a place where children cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a stop sign is coming up. Prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign indicates that traffic from the right is merging into your lane. Be prepared to adjust your speed or change lanes to allow safe merging.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you traffic is merging from the right side. Be ready to make room for vehicles entering your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that bicycles may be crossing or traveling in the area. Stay alert and be ready to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. Slow down and drive with caution in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
Only stop to yield to other traffic.
Vehicles will be entering the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. You must stop completely. Let all crossing traffic and pedestrians pass. Then proceed when safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates, disabled veteran plates, or disability parking placards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and animal-drawn carts display an orange and red triangle on the back.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells you that roadwork is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices when driving through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is ahead. Start slowing down when you see this warning sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions immediately ahead. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is displayed on slow-moving vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs mark construction, maintenance, survey, and utility work zones. They help drivers and pedestrians navigate safely through these areas. Traffic fines may double in zones marked by these signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming.
